title: Validate E170 GUI load and undo
changes: Verify actual GUI Load, Undo and reload with the current E170 base dataset against an isolated raw-ROM session on the recorded Bank route.
validation: Wine/Xvfb e170-gui-load-undo-post-o9pxy5_a passes: the same 120-frame input runs before and after actual menu Load/Undo/reload, and raw and managed complete-state hashes and clocks match at all six endpoints. The managed range counter records 46 bytes across both passes; the otherwise equivalent single-pass GUI unit w0cdul_b records 23. Copied slots and protected inputs remain unchanged, both GUI sessions exit normally, Wine drains and successful scratch is removed.
limitations: The counter is aggregate, not per-phase attribution; state and clock are compared at endpoints, not video/audio each frame. Generated dispatch may fall back to interpretation; this does not use a personal save or prove native Windows, other scenes, backup restore or mod behavior.

Initial unit 2myj8gap stopped before Load because its driver looked for an obsolete submenu. The current Main menu has direct Load and Undo actions. Wine logged transient debug-control access-denied messages and a D-Bus assertion during the passing run; controls and exits succeeded. The debugging workflow requested Terra xhigh as primary, but the effective primary model and effort were not independently confirmed.
